title: HuggingFace deps crawl at 1.66 MB/s - aria2's 16 ranged GETs fight HF's request-count limiter
description: Measured on the live download Pod 2026-08-08, sampling /comfy/downloads/status every 15s for 2 min on h3-qwen3vl-32b-clip: 1.66 MB/s MEAN, and the shape is a token bucket, not a flat rate - bursts to ~3.8 collapsing to ~0.5. ~62GB of MiniMax H3 left = ~10 hours, blocking the MPI-467 smoke fill and Gate E on 1.4 (MPI-450). Sample at 15s or not at all: one long interval lands mid-burst and reads ~2x optimistic. WHY ONLY H3: every other weight comes from R2, where the same aria2c measured ~533 MB/s (wrapper.py:1792). H3 is the only HF-primary family with no R2 copy and that is PERMANENT - the MiniMax CLA's trigger covers 'reproducing, modifying, distributing', so pointing the dep at Comfy-Org's own repo is what kills the section III redistribution claim (MPI-449 research.md section 0, restated at modelDeps.js:425-433). DO NOT 'FIX' THIS BY STAGING H3 TO R2. LEADING CAUSE: _download_aria2 (wrapper.py:1770) fires -x 16 -s 128 -k 1M ranged GETs at huggingface.co/.../resolve/..., and HF's published limit is REQUEST-COUNT not bandwidth (3000 resolver requests per 5 min shared across an anonymous IP), so multi-connection ranged downloading burns the quota and drops into 429-sleep cycles - which is exactly a bursting bucket. MPI-148 recorded the other face of the same conflict (the Xet CDN 403ing ranged aria2, Dockerfile:345) and fixed it by moving those weights to R2, which H3 cannot do. A SECOND MECHANISM makes it self-reinforcing and is specific to our flags: --lowest-speed-limit=1M (wrapper.py:1815) aborts any connection under 1 MB/s for 30s, so with 16 connections sharing a 1.7 MB/s bucket EVERY connection is under the floor, aria2 kills and re-establishes them continuously, and each reconnect is another resolver request. Under that reading aria2 is not failing to help, it is digging the hole. PLAN: measure before adding a dependency. Arm B is one condition at wrapper.py:2027 routing huggingface.co to the wrapper's existing _download_httpx (single sequential GET, already has Range resume, 5 retries, stall detection, cancel, progress, ENOSPC) - zero new deps, ships on the runtime float. Only if that loses does hf_xet (Arm C) get built, and that needs a pip install in start-cpu.sh because the -cpu image the download Pod actually runs has NO huggingface_hub and publish-runtime.sh floats code, not packages.
